caseName: Catalytic, Inc. v. National Labor Relations Board
caseNameFull: Catalytic, Inc. v. National Labor Relations Board

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Certiorari granted, the judgment, insofar as it pertains to Samuel Thrach, is vacated, and the case is remanded to the Court of Appeals with directions that the case be remanded to the National Labor Relations Board for further consideration in light of Clear Pine Mouldings, Inc., 268 N. L. R. B. 1044 (1984).
